We are rank 132 of 3,979 at 0.959, 17th of 21 in the block, with 115 teams >= 0.960. All timers and watchers are alive. ONE REAL BUG must be fixed before the 07:23Z prep. The A-M2 bullet in R30-A2 (a), which CONTEXT 02:02Z (5) tells the prep to follow, reads "DIS '?' -> exp89q only if P is '+' or '?'". It drops the Rr '+' condition required by MORNING TABLE v1.1 (2), 21:11Z (6) and R30-A1 (3). Taken literally, it sends exp89q in cells where v1.1 says UNUSED: exp89r = 0.959 with exp89p = 0.959 or '?', and exp89r ERROR, late or a late 0/- with P '+' or '?'. Smaller items: (B) card v5 pool wording ('insertion gate not fired' = non-CI L_hi <= 8.0 h) contradicts the logged V_pub pool (non-CI L_hi <= 9.0 h, 'v' suffix). (C) The '08:40Z header' does not exist on the poller's cadence (~08:34 / ~08:44, and the standby shifts the phase). (D) No plan exists if the laptop is still asleep or on battery after 06:00Z. (E) The 'rounds 07:13-10:13Z read-only' advice was never logged, so the 07:13Z timer will start a full round next to the prep and the exp89p read.

findings.what: R30-A2 (a) A-M2 bullet list omits the Rr '+' condition on the exp89q branch, and the 07:23Z prep will paste it verbatim (CONTEXT 02:02Z (5): 'decision grid ... per round30/report.json R30-A2'). The bullet reads: "DIS '?' -> exp89q only if P is '+' or '?'. With P '0' / '-' -> UNUSED." The Rr '+' bullet defines Rr but never uses it. The logged rules all require Rr '+': MORNING TABLE v1.1 (2) says 'DIS + -> exp89s; else Rr + -> exp89q; else UNUSED'; 21:11Z (6) and R30-A1 (3) say 'Rr + with DIS ? -> exp89q'. Cells where the literal text sends exp89q but v1.1 says UNUSED: (i) d_R = 0.959, d_P = 0.959 (d_R - d_P = 0, so DIS '?', P '+'); (ii) d_R = 0.959, P '?' (exp89p ERROR or late); (iii) exp89r ERROR or not terminal by the 11:00Z header, so DIS cannot be computed ('?'), with P '+' or '?'; (iv) exp89r read after 10:17:28Z at <= 0.958, which GAP RULE v2 (5) turns into '?' rather than '-', with P '+'. Cell (i) is realistic: 0.959 is the modal display for both files. A wrong exp89q sends a SEC+DIS non-CI file that no winner supports and uses the last slot of 29 Sep.

CONTEXT.md 28 Sep 14:12 UTC MORNING TABLE v1.1 (2) BRANCH A M2; 28 Sep 21:11 UTC entry item (6); 29 Sep 02:02 UTC entry items (3) and (5). DIS definitions: '+' iff d_R - d_P >= 0.003 and d_R > max(0.959, d_P); '-' iff d_R - d_P <= -0.001; else '?'. The R30-A2 grids list only d_R = 0.960 / 0.961, where Rr '+' holds implicitly, so the grids are right and only the bullet is wrong.

Card l.17 says 'COMPLETE; гейт вставки не сработал'; the POOL_TABLE placeholder says 'with the insertion gate not fired'. For non-CI (safetail) files that means ledger L_hi <= 8.0 h. The logged rules say otherwise: CONTEXT l.3179 has 'V_pub = the highest display among COMPLETE ... refs with L_hi <= 9.0 h (non-CI) or <= 10.75 h (CI)'; L9 (4) l.2700-2702 says 'A V* displaying >= 0.955 with 8.0 < L_hi <= 9.0 h stays eligible' (the gate is per clip and L includes queue and poll gap); 'v' suffix rule l.3021; R30-A1 (1) says 'exp89p enters the V_pub pool only with L_hi <= 9.0 h'. The two diverge if exp89p (after 08:46:36Z), exp89s or exp89q reads 8.0-9.0 h after submit at the top display. The card would drop a file the rules make V_pub (e.g. exp89p 0.960 read at 08:50Z).

findings.what: The A-M1 limit 'latest the 08:40Z header' is not guaranteed to exist. R30-A1 (4) turns it into L_hi <= 7.9 h, i.e. a first COMPLETE header stamped <= 08:40:36Z. The poller runs every ~10 min +2 s (02:04:06Z, 02:14:07Z). Without a phase shift its headers fall at ~08:34:2x and ~08:44:2x, so a read that lands between ~08:34Z and 08:40:36Z first shows at ~08:44Z and fails L_hi <= 7.9 h. A-M1 would then be UNUSED although exp89l could still go by 08:45Z. The 05:10-06:00Z standby shifts the phase unpredictably (time.sleep across Modern Standby). The 08:30Z timer text ('a missing read = UNUSED') and R30-A2 (c) ('wait for the 08:40Z header') both assume that header exists.
